description: This file performs image cropping operations and visualization within a graphical window, demonstrating cropping and animation of images using the p5.lua-like framework.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the window, loads an image, performs cropping, and prints sizes of images.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Handles rendering of images, background, and text; updates positions for animation and handles boundary collisions.
